CHAP. VIII. 
 
  Solomon's buildings, ver. 1-6.   His workmen and officers, ver. 7-10.   He settles his wife, ver. 11.   Fixes the method of the temple service, ver. 12-16.   His trade, ver. 17, 18.
V. 11. The house-He built this house for her; because the ark was now in the house of David, which therefore ought to be kept pure and free from the very danger and appearance of pollution.
V. 14.  Man of God-A prophet inspired by God in these matters, whose commands therefore are the commands of God.
V. 16. Prepared-All the materials were procured, and in all points fitted and compleated before-hand.
